about-us.title: Meet the Super Ninis! 👋
about-us.description: We're a small but mighty team of game developers who believe that great games don't need to be serious to be seriously fun! We pour our hearts, creativity, and a healthy dose of silliness into every project. Our mission? To turn procrastination into inspiration and deliver games that are small in size but BIG on fun!

developers.title: Passionate Developers
developers.description: Creating joy one line of code at a time. We love tackling challenges and bringing innovative gameplay mechanics to life.

artists.title: Creative Artists
artists.description: Making the world more colorful with unique art styles and charming characters. Every pixel is crafted with love

sound.title: Sound Wizards
sound.description: Adding bops, beeps, and emotional scores to your gameplay. We believe sound is half the experience!

designers.title: Storytellers & Designers
designers.description: Weaving narratives and designing experiences that are engaging, memorable, and, most importantly, fun!

our-philosophy.title: Our Philosophy
our-philosophy.description: At Los Super Ninis, we embrace the "Nini" spirit – that spark of genius that strikes when you're *supposed* to be doing something else.
